gates.name: F10 casing timing: cause measured and fixed (gate unchanged)

value.cause: all 15 G10c play tests: 5954 / 5954 ShellEject events 0.0375 s after the START of the shot's frame, 0 frames with two shots: the weapon meshes tick after the gun, so a fire clip started in the gun's Tick was advanced by the whole frame (a 23 ms frame in the F14 burst put 1-2 casings out of tolerance). Not catch-up shots.
value.fix: ANinjaGun::HoldClipThisFrame pauses the just-started fire clip (both copies) until the first Tick of a later frame
value.first_try: play rate 0 instead of pause: no effect (FAnimMontageInstance's sub-stepper banks DeltaTime and spent it at the restored rate: 2 frames' advance in one, fireclip probe); a run on that build failed F10 391/393

method: Diagnose (g10d_fp_diag_game.py: bones in camera space, material lists, A/B frames, runtime offset variants A-I), then C++: UNinjaGunComponent FirstPersonBodyOffset / FirstPersonReloadBodyOffset (hand_r IK shift in hand_r space -> root solve moves the body), material copy + LOD 0 on show, FirstPersonPouchOffset, FirstPersonReloadOffset retuned, FPReloadAlpha follows the hand path weight (0.1 s); ANinjaGun HoldClipThisFrame (pause). Measured and filmed by g10d_reload_probe_game.py (G10c's probe + FP screen / arm checks, fill light off for FP), FP views by g10d_fp_views_game.py, fire clip by g10d_fireclip_probe_game.py; sheets by g10d_contact_sheet.py.
honest_notes: No content was rebuilt this round (C++ and tool scripts only); ABP_GunCharacter, BP_GunCharacter and the clips are as G10c left them.
The FP body and the 3P body now differ by design: the FP body sits 16 cm lower (28 cm during the reload) than a body holding FP_Weapon with the 3P pose would; only the owner sees it.
The FP pouch is higher and further forward than the 3P pouch (36, -9, 34 vs 32, -9, 26) so the off-screen dip is short; the 3P pouch is unchanged.

An intermediate play test (rate-0 hold build) failed F10 391/393 - the reason the hold was changed to a pause. The final runs' longest burst frame was 13.6-15.4 ms, so the 23 ms case did not recur; by construction the casing now lands in [0.0375, 0.0375 + its frame) after the shot frame, inside F10's tolerance (its frame + 12.5 ms).

Not addressed (3P, reported by the reviewer, the orchestrator judged 3P right): a light patch on the shaded left upper arm when it bends (shading, the arm is on the sun's shadow side), no pouch mesh, the charging-handle rack is hard to read from the left, the forearm near the chest at 0.86-0.90 s.
The CardShopLab editor (another project) may have been open; builds used the normal UBT path; DemoGame_1 was closed throughout.
